source: AWS Pricing API GetProducts, region us-west-2; GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra and Claude Sonnet 5.5 (global profile) from the model cards and Price List files named in their rows. The rows are the models of engine/catalog/models.json that have a price; GLM 5.3 (us.zai.glm-5.3) has none yet.

models.source: AmazonBedrockFoundationModels, Claude Opus 5.5 (Amazon Bedrock Edition), USW2-MP:USW2_*_tokens_standard-Units; cacheWrite is the 5-minute TTL

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-openai-gpt-6-1-sol.html, US CRIS (bedrock-runtime), Standard tier, short context (272K input tokens or fewer); the Price List files list no Sol SKU; cacheWrite is the card's 1.25x input rate and cacheRead its 0.05x, the only ones listed

https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-openai-gpt-6-astra.html, Geo CRIS, Standard tier, short context (272K input tokens or fewer); the Price List (AmazonBedrockFoundationModels, USW2-MP:USW2_*_tokens_standard-Units) agrees; cacheWrite is the card's 30-minute cache write, the only one listed

AmazonBedrockFoundationModels, Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Amazon Bedrock Edition), USW2-MP:USW2_{input,cache_write,cache_read,output}_tokens_global_standard-Units (the global profile; the geo and in-Region rows are 10% dearer: 2.2, 2.75, 0.22, 11.0); cacheWrite is the 5-minute TTL
